title: Goyang Sikit
subject: a wedding reception that refuses to end
caption: Dangdut koplo. A driving kendang koplo groove with the signature sliding drum fills, suling bamboo flute answering every vocal phrase, electric organ stabs, tabla and a walking bass. A female lead sings with heavy cengkok ornamentation, nasal and forward, wailing melismatic runs at the ends of lines. Crisp modern mixing, punchy low end, loud and danceable. 128 BPM, G minor. Relentless, joyous.
lyrics:
[Intro - Suling]

[Verse 1]
Pukul dua belas dah lama lepas
Pengantin dah masuk bilik
Tapi orang tua-tua ni
Tak nak balik lagi

[Pre-Chorus]
DJ cakap lagu last
Dia dah cakap tujuh kali

[Chorus]
Goyang sikit, goyang sikit
Kaki sakit pun goyang juga
Esok kerja, esok fikir
Malam ni kita menang dulu

[Verse 2]
Pak Cik tu tak kenal siapa pengantin
Dia lalu, dia dengar, dia masuk
Sekarang dia depan sekali
Tak ada orang nak halau

[Suling Solo]

[Chorus]
Goyang sikit, goyang sikit
Kaki sakit pun goyang juga
Esok kerja, esok fikir
Malam ni kita menang dulu

[Outro]
Satu lagu lagi!
Satu lagu lagi!
